newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted mostly steady on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Monday. No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- One barge, Mid-Mississippi River, this week, similar from July 22, down 2-1/2 percentage points to bid at 115 percent of tarrif, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 115 percent, unchanged from July 21, offer 120 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offer 105 percent, similar, unchanged from July 21.
- Five barges, Illinois River, one each week of August, bid 115 percent, unchanged from July 22, similar, offer 120 percent, unchanged from from July 22, similar.
